# agent-sandstorm
> Zero-Trust Agent Execution Sandbox & Copy-on-Write Workspace Isolation Engine (Node.js/TypeScript + Python)

## Entity Metadata
- entity: agent-sandstorm
- brand: Built by Jalen / Nymrel
- parentOrganization: Nymrel
- legalParent: JalenBuilds LLC
- contact: contact@nymrel.com
- license: MIT
- repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-sandstorm
- languageParity: Node.js (TypeScript) & Python (>=3.9)

## Capabilities
1. Copy-on-Write (CoW) Workspace Isolation: Instant Merkle tree snapshotting and 1-click atomic rollback on agent errors or malicious modifications.
2. Outbound Network Proxy & Secret Exfiltration Scanner: Intercepts HTTP/CONNECT outbound requests, scans bodies/headers/URLs for multi-cloud secrets (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, GitHub, GCP, PEM private keys, JWT, Slack, Stripe), and blocks exfiltration with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
3. Spend Budget & Rate Limiting: Real-time LLM token cost tracking with customizable pricing tables and hard USD spend caps.
4. Runaway Recursive Loop Brake: Sliding-window n-gram cycle detection (periods 1 to 5) halting infinite agent loops and tool call thrashing.
5. Cryptographic SHA-256 Audit Log: Tamper-evident hash-chained event journal with visual ASCII timeline exporter and standalone interactive HTML dashboard generator.

## TypeScript / Node.js Quickstart
```typescript
import { Sandstorm } from '@nymrel/agent-sandstorm';

const sandbox = new Sandstorm({
  workspace: './my-project',
  allowDomains: ['api.openai.com', 'registry.npmjs.org'],
  maxSpendUsd: 2.00,
  maxSteps: 50,
  autoRollbackOnError: true,
});

const result = await sandbox.run(async (ctx) => {
  ctx.recordTokenUsage('gpt-4o', 1200, 300);
  await ctx.exec('npm install');
  await ctx.exec('node agent.js');
});
```

## Python Quickstart
```python
from agent_sandstorm import Sandstorm

sandbox = Sandstorm(
    workspace="./my-project",
    allow_domains=["api.openai.com", "pypi.org"],
    max_spend_usd=2.00,
    auto_rollback_on_error=True,
)

result = sandbox.run(lambda ctx: ctx.exec("python agent.py"))
```

## CLI Reference
- `sandstorm run <command...>`: Run command inside protected sandbox
- `sandstorm snapshot [name]`: Create CoW snapshot
- `sandstorm rollback [snapshotId]`: Restore workspace to snapshot
- `sandstorm diff`: View modified, added, deleted files
- `sandstorm commit [name]`: Commit changes to baseline
- `sandstorm audit [--html <path>] [--verify]`: Verify SHA-256 audit log integrity
- `sandstorm proxy [--port <port>] [--allow <domain...>]`: Start outbound Zero-Trust proxy
